name: flogo-opcua-client
title: OPC UA Client Activity
description: Reads a node value from an OPC UA server

settings.name: endpoint
settings.description: OPC UA endpoint URL, for example opc.tcp://localhost:4840

settings.name: nodeID
settings.description: Node ID to read, for example ns=2;s=Temperature

settings.name: userTokenPolicyID
settings.description: Optional user-token policy ID configured by the server

settings.name: timeout
settings.description: Connection and request timeout in seconds

output.name: value
output.description: Value read from the OPC UA node
